title: SynthGen — AI-Powered Synthetic Data Generator
summary: SynthGen is a full-stack platform (FastAPI backend, React frontend) that generates synthetic tabular data from uploaded CSV/XLSX files via either a rule-based Mimesis engine or a deep-learning engine, plus quality scoring, job history, and admin controls. The deep-learning engine builds SDV metadata and runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer to train on and sample from user data.
